shrimp_noodles.title: Rice noodles with shrimp
shrimp_noodles.text: Cook rice noodles with shrimp together. Cheap, tasty and every bit as good as a restaurant night.
shrimp_noodles.surprise: While your partner is at work, cook noodles with shrimp and set the table. Dinner is waiting when they get home.
pasta_from_scratch.title: Pasta from scratch
pasta_from_scratch.text: Knead the dough, cut the pasta and invent your own sauce. Wine or lemonade, your call.
candle_dinner.title: Candlelit dinner at home
candle_dinner.text: Turn off the lights, light some candles and cook something simple together.
candle_dinner.surprise: Set it all up in advance: candles, a tablecloth, your partner's favourite dish. Then just call them to the table.
movie_night.title: Movie night under a blanket
movie_night.text: Popcorn, a blanket and a film you've both been meaning to watch.
movie_night.surprise: Find the film your partner keeps mentioning, make popcorn and have the blanket ready before they're home.
sushi_night.title: Sushi night
sushi_night.text: Order a big sushi set and binge a few episodes. No dishes to wash.
sushi_night.surprise: Order your partner's favourite set for when they get home and serve it on a low table with cushions.
spa_evening.title: Home spa evening
spa_evening.text: Scented oil, soft towels and a slow massage, taking turns.
spa_evening.surprise: Turn the bathroom into a spa: candles, oil, warm towels. Then give your partner a massage, no turn-taking.
bath_evening.title: A bath for two
bath_evening.text: Warm water, bubbles and nowhere to be.
bath_evening.surprise: Run a bubble bath, put on music and pour their favourite drink. They'll get the rest.
board_game_night.title: New board game night
board_game_night.text: Get a board game you've never played and hold a tournament with forfeits.
quiz_night.title: A quiz about the two of you
quiz_night.text: Take turns asking each other questions: favourites, firsts, funniest moments. Who knows whom better?
video_game_night.title: Co-op game night
video_game_night.text: Pick a two-player game and beat a few levels together. Snacks required.
playlist_night.title: Playlist night
playlist_night.text: Each of you adds five songs that mean something. Listen and tell each other why.
travel_dreams.title: Plan a dream trip
travel_dreams.text: Open a map and pick a place you'd go to tomorrow if you could.
fantasy_talk.title: An evening of honest talk
fantasy_talk.text: Wine or tea, phones away and a few questions you've never asked each other.
wine_tasting_home.title: Wine tasting at home
wine_tasting_home.text: Three or four different wines, a cheese board and scores out of five.
wine_tasting_home.surprise: Buy a few wines and cheeses, make little scoring cards and host a surprise tasting.
chef_at_home.title: A private chef at home
chef_at_home.text: Book a private chef to cook a multi-course dinner right in your kitchen.
chef_at_home.surprise: Book a private chef while your partner is at work. A restaurant for two will be waiting at home.
city_walk.title: A walk through a new neighbourhood
city_walk.text: Pick a part of town you rarely visit and finish in a cosy cafe.
city_walk.surprise: Plan a route through places that mean something to you both and lead your partner without saying where.
nature_picnic.title: A picnic outside the city
nature_picnic.text: A blanket, snacks and a quiet spot by the water.
nature_picnic.surprise: Pack a basket of treats and take your partner to a picnic they didn't see coming.
hike_sunset.title: A sunset hike
hike_sunset.text: A short trail to a viewpoint, timed for the sunset.
street_food_tour.title: A street food tour
street_food_tour.text: Three stops, three different bites, one shared score.
brunch_date.title: A slow brunch
brunch_date.text: A weekend morning, pancakes and coffee at a new cafe.
brunch_date.surprise: Book a brunch table and wake your partner with 'get dressed, we're eating out'.
cinema_date.title: A movie and a walk
cinema_date.text: An evening screening, then talk it over on the walk home.
cinema_date.surprise: Buy tickets for the film your partner has been waiting for and tell them only when to be ready.
escape_room.title: An escape room
escape_room.text: One hour to get out together. You'll also find out who's the leader.
bowling_date.title: Bowling with stakes
bowling_date.text: Three games, each with a bet: the winner picks dessert.
karaoke_night.title: Karaoke for two
karaoke_night.text: A private booth, a duet of your choice and a song dedicated to each other.
standup_night.title: A stand-up night
standup_night.text: An open mic or a headline show. Laughing together brings you closer.
standup_night.surprise: Get tickets to a comedian your partner loves and only reveal them at the door.
dance_class.title: A trial dance class
dance_class.text: Salsa, bachata or tango. One lesson and you'll have a story to tell.
new_place_date.title: Somewhere new
new_place_date.text: A restaurant or bar neither of you has been to.
new_place_date.surprise: Find a place your partner hasn't heard of and take them there blind.
pottery_class.title: A pottery class
pottery_class.text: Hands in clay, mugs to keep and lots of laughs.
pottery_class.surprise: Book a class for two and only tell your partner to wear something they don't mind ruining.
concert_date.title: A concert
concert_date.text: Live music, a band you both like and voices lost from singing along.
concert_date.surprise: Buy tickets to an artist your partner loves and hand them over in an envelope.
theatre_date.title: A night at the theatre
theatre_date.text: A play, a glass of bubbly at the interval and dinner after.
theatre_date.surprise: Buy tickets and ask your partner to dress up. Keep where you're going a secret.
adrenaline_day.title: An adrenaline day
adrenaline_day.text: Go-karts, a rope park or anything that gets your heart racing.
luxury_dinner.title: Dinner at a luxury restaurant
luxury_dinner.text: A chef's tasting menu, wine pairing and a night to remember.
luxury_dinner.surprise: Book a table at the best restaurant in town and tell your partner only the dress code.
balloon_flight.title: A hot air balloon flight
balloon_flight.text: Sunrise, silence and the city from above. Bubbly after landing.
balloon_flight.surprise: Book a flight and wake your partner before dawn. They'll find out where you're going when you get there.
love_letter.title: A handwritten letter
love_letter.text: Write what you're grateful for and hide it where your partner will find it.
breakfast_in_bed.title: Breakfast in bed
breakfast_in_bed.text: Coffee, a croissant and a note on the tray. Best on a day with nowhere to be.
flowers_no_reason.title: Flowers for no reason
flowers_no_reason.text: A small bouquet for no reason means more than a big one on a holiday.
photo_book.title: A photo book of your moments
photo_book.text: Collect the best photos of the year and caption each with a few words.
board_game_gift.title: A two-player board game
board_game_gift.text: A game made for couples, plus an evening to play it together.
coffee_set.title: A roaster's coffee set
coffee_set.text: A few freshly roasted beans and a nice mug to go with them.
cooking_class_gift.title: A cooking class voucher
cooking_class_gift.text: Learn to cook a cuisine you both love, together.
concert_tickets.title: Concert tickets
concert_tickets.text: Your partner's favourite artist, with you by their side.
spa_certificate.title: A spa day for two
spa_certificate.text: Massage, sauna and a whole day without phones.
wine_gift.title: A collectible wine
wine_gift.text: A bottle from the year you met, or from a region you dream of visiting.
skydive_gift.title: A skydive
skydive_gift.text: A tandem jump voucher for someone who has been dreaming of it.
surprise_weekend_gift.title: A surprise weekend away
surprise_weekend_gift.text: Tickets and a hotel in another city. Your partner only has to pack.
jewelry_gift.title: Jewellery with a story
jewelry_gift.text: Engraved with a date or a word only the two of you understand.
sweets_gift.title: A box of favourite sweets
sweets_gift.text: A small treat for no reason that is sure to land.
spirits_gift.title: A bottle of good whisky
spirits_gift.text: Not just any bottle but one with a story: a single malt or an aged cognac.
book_gift.title: A book with a dedication
book_gift.text: A book that reminded you of your partner, with a few words on the first page.
perfume_gift.title: Perfume
perfume_gift.text: A scent that will remind you of each other.
clothes_gift.title: Something they've wanted for a while
clothes_gift.text: A sweater, a dress or sneakers your partner has been eyeing.
camping_trip.title: Camping by a lake
camping_trip.text: A tent, a campfire and the stars. Cheap, with memories for a year.
nearby_weekend.title: A weekend in a nearby town
nearby_weekend.text: Two days, a small hotel and a town you've never been to.
backpack_trip.title: A backpacking trip
backpack_trip.text: Hostels, trains and a new route every day.
mountain_trip.title: A mountain trip
mountain_trip.text: Trails, fresh air and a warm cabin in the evening.
country_house.title: A countryside house
country_house.text: A cottage with a pool or a fireplace, just the two of you.
road_trip.title: A road trip
road_trip.text: A car, a playlist and stops wherever you like.
train_trip.title: A train journey
train_trip.text: A night train, tea on the way and a new city in the morning.
beach_trip.title: A beach holiday
beach_trip.text: Sun, sea and a lounger. The only plan is no plans.
city_break.title: A city break
city_break.text: Three days in a city you both want to discover.
all_inclusive_trip.title: An all-inclusive hotel
all_inclusive_trip.text: A week with no thinking about meals or plans.
food_trip.title: A food trip
food_trip.text: A city people visit for its food: markets, wineries and restaurants.
ski_trip.title: A ski resort
ski_trip.text: Slopes by day, mulled wine and a fireplace at night.
cruise_trip.title: A cruise
cruise_trip.text: A new port every morning and the sea all around.
villa_trip.title: A villa by the sea
villa_trip.text: Your own pool, silence and no one but the two of you.
